body:
## Problem

Ground truth (`packages/frontend/data/endorsementNews.js`, `art-cruz` entry): `drums: { brand: 'Ludwig', model: 'Black Beauty (14x6.5")', since: '2019' }` — Art Cruz has played a Ludwig kit anchored by the **Black Beauty** snare since joining Lamb of God in 2019. "Ludwig Classic Maple" is not a real/endorsed product line for him.

`packages/frontend/data/albumArticles/art-cruz.js` correctly says "Black Beauty-anchored kit" in its Omens (2022) article section (lines ~629-789) — fixed by closed PR **#8431** (closing #8409). But the SAME FILE's debut-era sections ("self-titled 2020" drumKit block and the "whats-in-art-cruzs-kit" FAQ) still fabricate "Ludwig Classic Maple" at multiple locations, confirmed still live:

- Line ~43: `"title": "Cruz's Debut Setup: The Ludwig Classic Maple"`
- Line ~45: `"model": "Ludwig Classic Maple"`
- Line ~61: "...Art Cruz built his sound around a **Ludwig Classic Maple** kit..."
- Line ~67: `"estimatedValue": "$4,000-6,000 (Ludwig Classic Maple configuration)"`
- Line ~596 (FAQ): "Art Cruz currently plays a **Ludwig Classic Maple** kit with Lamb of God..."
- Line ~604 (FAQ): "A current **Ludwig Classic Maple** kit configured to Art Cruz's specifications runs approximately $4,000 to $6,000..."
- Plus additional occurrences in the same drumKit/description block (lines ~217, 225, 234, 281, 297, 299, 466, 476 — grep the whole file, not just the lines enumerated here, they are representative not exhaustive).

This is both a stale-data bug AND an internal self-contradiction (the same file's Omens section already correctly says Black Beauty).

## Fix

Replace every "Ludwig Classic Maple" occurrence in `packages/frontend/data/albumArticles/art-cruz.js` (outside the already-correct Omens section) with the verified Ludwig kit anchored by the **Black Beauty (14x6.5")** snare — match the exact phrasing already used in the Omens section ("Black Beauty-anchored kit") for consistency. Update the `"estimatedValue"` dollar range only if the cited source actually supports a different Black-Beauty-based estimate; otherwise keep the range and just correct the model name.

## Verify

1. `grep -n "Classic Maple" packages/frontend/data/albumArticles/art-cruz.js` returns zero matches.
2. `grep -n "Black Beauty" packages/frontend/data/albumArticles/art-cruz.js` shows the debut-era section now matches the Omens section's phrasing.
3. Confirm the FAQ answers (~line 596, ~604) and the drumKit title (~line 43) all now say Black Beauty, not Classic Maple.
4. No new file created; URL unchanged (additive-refresh only).

## Done

`albumArticles/art-cruz.js` consistently describes Art Cruz's Ludwig kit as Black Beauty-anchored across all sections (debut-era and Omens-era) — zero remaining "Classic Maple" fabrications.
title: SEO: Art Cruz debut-era article still fabricates 'Ludwig Classic Maple' (nonexistent line) — #8431 only fixed the Omens section of the same file
